data.one_liner: Minimalistic Flutter widgets heavily inspired by shadcn/ui.
data.what_it_does: Forui is a Flutter UI library providing over 50 minimalistic, customizable widgets designed for desktop and touch devices, heavily inspired by shadcn/ui.
use_when: You want a modern, shadcn-inspired design system for your Flutter app.
You need a comprehensive set of styled components for desktop or mobile.
avoid_when: You strictly need native Material Design or Cupertino style guidelines without overriding them.
strengths: Over 50 crafted widgets with interactive theme building and CLI support.
First-class Flutter Hooks integration via companion packages.
Active maintenance and good platform support.
weaknesses: Requires a very recent Flutter version (3.47.0+).
Niche design style that might not fit standard Material-heavy UX expectations.
